axioms.name: Experimental.P06_13.upstream_secant_laplace_expansion
axioms.meaning: Base undifferentiated expansion 1/(2 cosh z)=sum (-1)^n exp(-(2n+1)z) for z>0; no central-factorial or differentiated conclusion is assumed.

typed_coverage: The concrete secant kernel, its base series, and the finite differential operator are typed. Existing exponential-series summability is available as a starting estimate.
missing_domain_interfaces: Port the already reported donor finite operator proof after checking its source/dependency identity; establish local uniform differentiated convergence; construct the actual coupled beta pencil.
repair_gates: The printed differentiated series has a missing global (−1)^(k−1) factor. Do not assume the literal printed series.
The endpoint is Xi_k, a beta combination with pi-dependent coefficients; this is not an individual beta irrationality theorem.
Strict Newton inequalities need their correct multiplicity/nondegeneracy conditions, not genericity.
validation: Static source review only; no Lean process, build or axiom audit run.
